commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent group inventorysvc >/dev/null; then groupadd --system inventorysvc; fi
if ! getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null; then useradd --system --gid inventorysvc --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /sbin/nologin --comment 'Inventory Worker Service' inventorysvc; fi
passwd -l inventorysvc >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventorysvc

set -eu
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'INVENTORY_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
INVENTORY_UNIT
restorecon -v /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID -p User -p Group -p ExecMainStatus -p SubState -p ActiveState
pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
ps -o pid=,ppid=,user=,group=,stat=,args= -p "$pid"
printf '%s\n' '--- unit ---'
systemctl cat inventory-worker.service

commands.command:
set -eu
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
uid=$(id -u inventorysvc)
gid=$(id -g inventorysvc)
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'account_uid=%s account_gid=%s main_pid=%s\n' "$uid" "$gid" "$pid"
awk '/^(Name|State|Pid|PPid|Uid|Gid):/ {print}' "/proc/$pid/status"
printf 'cmdline='; tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline"; printf '\n'
systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p UnitFileState -p User -p Group -p ExecMainStatus
printf '%s\n' 'unit_verify=passed'
